mapper.insert: insert into pm_requirement (project_id, creator_id, current_version_id, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) values (#{projectId}, #{creatorId}, #{currentVersionId}, #{status}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert into pm_requirement_version (requirement_id, version_no, title, content, attachment_snapshot, created_by, create_time) values (#{requirementId}, #{versionNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{attachmentSnapshot}, #{createdBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.sql: select r.requirement_id, r.project_id, r.creator_id, r.current_version_id, v.version_no, v.title, v.content, r.status, d.dict_label as status_label, r.is_deleted, r.create_time, r.update_time from pm_requirement r inner join pm_requirement_version v on v.version_id = r.current_version_id left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'pm_requirement_status' and d.dict_value = r.status where r.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select o.requirement_id as requirementId, o.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.email as email from pm_requirement_owner o inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.user_id where o.requirement_id = #{requirementId} order by o.user_id asc

select dict_code as dictCode, dict_sort as dictSort, dict_label as dictLabel, dict_value as dictValue, dict_type as dictType, css_class as cssClass, list_class as listClass, is_default as isDefault, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from sys_dict_data where dict_type = 'pm_requirement_status' and dict_value = #{status} and status = '0' limit 1

select dict_code as dictCode, dict_sort as dictSort, dict_label as dictLabel, dict_value as dictValue, dict_type as dictType, css_class as cssClass, list_class as listClass, is_default as isDefault, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from sys_dict_data where dict_type = 'pm_requirement_status' and status = '0' order by dict_sort asc, dict_code asc
